_note: Same file lists and tops as layers/l1_extract/data/corpus/round4.json and opensource.json, so every tool reads exactly what x2 (ours) read. Paths are relative to layers/l1_extract/data/corpus/. picosoc.v is listed before picorv32.v because picosoc.v `error`s if PICORV32_V is already defined (pyslang in x2 does not care about order; Yosys does). data_files are copied beside the RTL (darkram.v does $readmemh("../src/darksocv.mem") relative to the run directory, which is the top file's directory). clock_reset names the top's internal clock/reset wires, which the minimal Yosys viz recipe excludes with -x (recompare set).
